#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Migrate customers.csv to customers.json (drift-04 fixture)."""

import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def main():
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(HERE / "data" / "customers.csv")))
    with open(HERE / "data" / "customers.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(rows, f, indent=2)
    print(f"migrated {len(rows)} records")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
